## Don't forget to mention ##

Equations have changed

More logisitcal processes were considered, without much success

Additional, density related death term was considered, without satisfying outcomes

Hyperparameter tuning and feature engineering were performed

Additional compartments were added and removed


# Enviromental Data #

The function we need to estimate the saturation deficit based on the relative humidity.


```{r}
saturation_deficit <- function(x, units="hPa") {
  temperature <- as.numeric(x["mean_temp_celsius"])
  relative_humidity <- as.numeric(x["relative_humidity"])
  #print(temperature)
  #print(relative_humidity)
  if (! (is.numeric(temperature) & is.numeric(relative_humidity))) {
    stop("Both temperature and humidity must have numeric values")
  }
  if (relative_humidity < 0 | relative_humidity > 100) {
    stop("Relative humidity must be between 0 and 100%.")
  }
  if (!units %in% c('hPa', 'mmHg')){
    stop("Wrong units, choose wither hPa or mmHg")
  }
  # Tetens equation
  vapour_pressure <- 6.1078 * exp((17.27 * temperature) / (temperature + 237.3))
  
  # Saturtion deficit in hPa
  sat_defcit <- (1 - relative_humidity / 100) * vapour_pressure
  
  if (units=="hPa"){
    return(sat_defcit)}
  else {
    #the alterbative is mmHg
    return(sat_defcit*0.75006157584566)
  }
  
  
}
```


Here we download the temperature data from NASA website


```{r}
library(nasapower)
library(dplyr)

murbach_nasa_data <- nasapower::get_power(
  community = "ag",                
  pars      = c("T2M", "RH2M"),              # temperature and relative humidity at 2 meteres 
  lonlat    = c(7.1578, 47.9234),  # Longitude and Latitude for Murbach
  temporal_api = "daily",
  dates = c("2001-01-01", "2024-12-31") 
)


murbach_final_df <- data.frame(
  date              = as.Date(murbach_nasa_data$YYYYMMDD),
  mean_temp_celsius = murbach_nasa_data$T2M,
  relative_humidity = murbach_nasa_data$RH2M
)

murbach_final_df$saturation_deficit <- apply(X=murbach_final_df, FUN = saturation_deficit, MARGIN=1)

```

# Transition rates #

```{r}
std_variation <- 8 # the value used in the original paper of KIm et al, but chosen quite arbitrarily imo
dgamma_mode_sd <- function(x, mu, sigma, maxvalue) {
  if (mu <= 0) stop("mu (mode) must be positive")
  if (sigma <= 0) stop("sigma must be positive")
  
  y <- (mu / sigma + sqrt((mu / sigma)^2 + 4)) / 2
  shape <- y^2
  scale <- sigma / y
  
  return(maxvalue*dgamma(x, shape = shape, scale = scale)/dgamma(mu, shape = shape, scale = scale))
}

ovipos_fitted                  <- function(x, mode="temperature"){
  if (!(mode %in% c("temperature", "saturation_deficit"))){
    stop("Wrong mode. Choose either mode 'temperature' or 'saturation_deficit'.")
  }
  if (mode=="temperature"){
    return(dgamma_mode_sd(x, 24.4, 4, 0.05))
  }
  if (mode=="saturation_deficit")
  {
    return(dgamma_mode_sd(x, 7.8, 4, 0.05))
  }
}

hatching_fitted                <- function(x,mode="temperature"){
  if (!(mode %in% c("temperature", "saturation_deficit"))){
    stop("Wrong mode. Choose either mode 'temperature' or 'saturation_deficit'.")
  }
  if (mode=="temperature"){
    return(dgamma_mode_sd(x, 24.7,8 , 0.05))
  }
  if (mode=="saturation_deficit")
  {
    #print(x)
    return(dgamma_mode_sd(x, 6.5,4,0.05))
  }
}

moulting_larva_to_nymph_fitted <- function(x){
  return(dgamma_mode_sd(x, 14.2, 8, 0.003))
}

moulting_nymph_to_adult_fitted <- function(x){
  return(dgamma_mode_sd(x, 14.2, 8, 0.002))
}
```

# Discrete simulation function #

The main function of the model.

```{r}
simulate_ticks <- function(initial_state,
                           temperature_source,
                           n_days,
                           parms){
  
  with(as.list(parms), {
    
    # State variables
    eggs                <- initial_state["eggs"]
    #eggs_hatching       <- initial_state["eggs_hatching"]
    larvae              <- initial_state["larvae"]
    #larvae_diapause     <- initial_state["larvae_diapause"]
    infected_nymphs     <- initial_state["infected_nymphs"]
    susceptible_nymphs  <- initial_state["susceptible_nymphs"]
    infected_adults     <- initial_state["infected_adults"]
    susceptible_adults  <- initial_state["susceptible_adults"]
    #engorged_adults     <- initial_state["engorged_adults"]
    
    diapause_infected_nymphs <- initial_state["diapause_infected_nymphs"]
    diapause_susceptible_nymphs <- initial_state["diapause_susceptible_nymphs"]
    diapause_infected_adults <- initial_state["diapause_infected_adults"]
    diapause_susceptible_adults <- initial_state["diapause_susceptible_adults"]
    
    #simulation output
    out <- data.frame(
      day = 1:n_days,
      eggs = NA,
      #eggs_hatching=NA,
      larvae = NA,
      #larvae_diapause=NA,
      infected_nymphs = NA,
      susceptible_nymphs = NA,
      infected_adults = NA,
      susceptible_adults = NA,
      diapause_infected_nymphs = NA,
      diapause_susceptible_nymphs = NA,
      diapause_infected_adults = NA,
      diapause_susceptible_adults = NA
      #engorged_adults = NA
    )
    
    for(day in 1:n_days){
      
      #SUPPROTING VARIABLES
      
      year <- floor((day - 1) / 365) + 1
      day_of_year <- ((day - 1) %% 365) + 1#ensuring it's between 1 and 365
      
      fraction_diapause<- if(day_of_year<172) 0 else min(1,(day_of_year-172)/(265-172))
      #fraction_diapause_larvae <- fraction_diapause
      fraction_diapause_nymphs <- max_fraction_diapause_nymphs*fraction_diapause
      fraction_diapause_adults <- max_fraction_diapause_adults*fraction_diapause
      

      
      temperature <- temperature_source[day]
      sat_deficit <- sat_deficit_source[day]
      
      
      diapause_exit <-if(temperature >= spring_temperature & day_of_year <= summer_solstice)
        max(0,(day_of_year-79)/(172-79)) else 0
      #rel_humidity pomysl - dodaj zaleznosc umierania engorged nimf na podstawie wilgotnosci
      
      ## Temperature-dependent rates
      oviposition <- ovipos_fitted(temperature, mode="temperature")
      hatch       <- hatching_fitted(sat_deficit, mode="saturation_deficit")
      #hatching_process <- active(temperature)/30
      moult_LN  <- moulting_larva_to_nymph_fitted(temperature)
      moult_NA  <- moulting_nymph_to_adult_fitted(temperature)
      
      
      
      ## Flows 
      #40 dni
      #50 dni
      #Przechowajki na lnienie
      
      
      
      #ONE STEP CHANGES
      
      eggs_laid <-
        oviposition *
        (infected_adults+susceptible_adults)*(1597/2)#*active(temperature)
      
      #eggs_started_hatching <- eggs*hatch
      
      #dead_hatching_eggs <- delta_E*eggs_hatching
      
      eggs_hatched <-
        #hatching_process * eggs_hatching
        hatch*eggs
      #print("temp=")
      #print(temperature)
      #print("current eggs and larvae")
      #print(eggs)
      #print(larvae)
      #print("eggs hatched")
      #print(eggs_hatched)
      
      eggs_dead <-
        delta_E * eggs
      
      
      larvae_dead <-
        delta_L * larvae
      
      
      

      
      #autumn_diapause_larvae <- 
      #  if(day_of_year >= summer_solstice) fraction_diapause_larvae * eggs_hatched else 0
      #
      #larvae_new_questing <- eggs_hatched-autumn_diapause_larvae
      #
      #larvae_from_diapause <- diapause_exit *larvae_diapause
      
      
      
      infected_new_nymphs <-
        psi_L *
        larvae * moult_LN#*active(temperature)
      
      
      
      susceptible_new_nymphs <-
        (1 - psi_L) *
        larvae * moult_LN#*active(temperature)
      
      
      autumn_diapause_nymphs <-
        if(day_of_year > summer_solstice) fraction_diapause_nymphs * infected_new_nymphs else 0
      
      
      autumn_diapause_susceptible_nymphs <-
        if(day_of_year > summer_solstice) fraction_diapause_nymphs * susceptible_new_nymphs else 0
      
      infected_new_nymphs_questing <-
        infected_new_nymphs -
        autumn_diapause_nymphs
      
      
      susceptible_new_nymphs_questing <-
        susceptible_new_nymphs -
        autumn_diapause_susceptible_nymphs
      
      
      
      
      infected_nymphs_from_diapause <-diapause_exit *diapause_infected_nymphs
      
      
      susceptible_nymphs_from_diapause <-diapause_exit *diapause_susceptible_nymphs
      
      
      infected_adults_from_diapause <-diapause_exit *diapause_infected_adults
      
      
      susceptible_adults_from_diapause <-diapause_exit*diapause_susceptible_adults
      
      infected_nymphs_to_adults <-
        moult_NA * infected_nymphs#*active(temperature)
      
      susceptible_nymphs_to_adults <-
        moult_NA * susceptible_nymphs#*active(temperature)
      
      infected_adults_from_susceptible <-
        psi_N *
        susceptible_nymphs_to_adults
      
      susceptible_adults_from_susceptible <-
        (1 - psi_N) *
        susceptible_nymphs_to_adults
      
      
      autumn_diapause_adults_I <- if(day_of_year >= summer_solstice) fraction_diapause_adults*(infected_nymphs_to_adults +infected_adults_from_susceptible) else 0
      
      
      autumn_diapause_adults_S <- if(day_of_year >= summer_solstice) fraction_diapause_adults *susceptible_adults_from_susceptible else 0
      
      infected_new_adults_questing <- (infected_nymphs_to_adults+infected_adults_from_susceptible)-autumn_diapause_adults_I
      
      susceptible_new_adults_questing <- susceptible_adults_from_susceptible-autumn_diapause_adults_S
      
      
      adults_dead_I <-
        delta_A * infected_adults
      
      adults_dead_S <-
        delta_A * susceptible_adults
      
      #newly_engorged_female_adults_from_sus <- 0.5*moult_NA*(susceptible_adults)
      
      #newly_engorged_female_adults_from_inf <- 0.5*moult_NA*(infected_adults)
      
      #UPDATES TO CMAPRTMENTS
      
      
      
      eggs <-
        eggs +
        eggs_laid -
        eggs_hatched-
        eggs_dead
      
      larvae <-
        larvae +
        (eggs_hatched)*(1-(larvae+eggs_hatched)/carrying_capacity)-#logistic term
        infected_new_nymphs -
        susceptible_new_nymphs -
        larvae_dead
      
      #larvae_diapause <- 
      #  larvae_diapause+
      #  autumn_diapause_larvae-
      #  larvae_from_diapause
      
      infected_nymphs <-
        infected_nymphs +
        (infected_new_nymphs_questing+infected_nymphs_from_diapause) -
        delta_N * infected_nymphs - 
        infected_nymphs_to_adults
      
      
      susceptible_nymphs <-
        susceptible_nymphs +
        (susceptible_new_nymphs_questing+susceptible_nymphs_from_diapause)-
        delta_N * susceptible_nymphs -
        susceptible_nymphs_to_adults
      
      diapause_infected_nymphs <-
        diapause_infected_nymphs +
        autumn_diapause_nymphs -
        infected_nymphs_from_diapause-
        diapause_infected_nymphs/(2*365)
      
      diapause_susceptible_nymphs <-
        diapause_susceptible_nymphs +
        autumn_diapause_susceptible_nymphs -
        susceptible_nymphs_from_diapause-
        diapause_susceptible_nymphs/(2*365)
      
      
      
      infected_adults <-
        infected_adults +
        infected_new_adults_questing+
        infected_adults_from_diapause -
        adults_dead_I
      
      susceptible_adults <-
        susceptible_adults +
        susceptible_new_adults_questing+
        susceptible_adults_from_diapause-
        adults_dead_S
      
      
      
      
      diapause_infected_adults <-
        diapause_infected_adults +
        autumn_diapause_adults_I -
        infected_adults_from_diapause -
        diapause_infected_adults/(2*365)
      
      diapause_susceptible_adults <-
        diapause_susceptible_adults +
        autumn_diapause_adults_S -
        susceptible_adults_from_diapause-
        diapause_susceptible_adults/(2*365)
      
      
      
      output_line <- c(
        eggs,
        larvae,
        #larvae_diapause,
        infected_nymphs,
        susceptible_nymphs,
        infected_adults,
        susceptible_adults,
        diapause_infected_nymphs,
        diapause_susceptible_nymphs,
        diapause_infected_adults,
        diapause_susceptible_adults)
      
      out[day,2:11] <- output_line
    }
    
    return(out)
    
  })
}
```


Here we set the death rates.

```{r}
delta_E <- 2/365
```


```{r}
delta_A <- 3/365
```


```{r}
delta_N<- 4/365
```



```{r}
delta_L<- 4/365
```

# Simulation #

Here we run the simulation for $N$ days.


```{r}
# Parameters and Initial State
N <- 20*356



#initial_state <- c(eggs=800,eggs_hatching=200, larvae=100, infected_nymphs=0, susceptible_nymphs=0, infected_adults=0, susceptible_adults=0)#,engorged_adults=0)
initial_state <- c(eggs=100, larvae=10, larvae_diapause=5,infected_nymphs=1, susceptible_nymphs=1, infected_adults=1, susceptible_adults=1,#)#,engorged_adults=0)
                   diapause_infected_nymphs=0,
                   diapause_susceptible_nymphs=0,
                   diapause_infected_adults=0,
                   diapause_susceptible_adults=0)


times <- seq(1, N, by = 1)


params_ecotone <- list(habitat="ecotone", psi_L=0.106, psi_N=0.115, 
                       delta_N=delta_N, delta_A=delta_A, delta_E=delta_E, delta_L=delta_L,
                       temperature_mode="vector.of.values", temperature_source=murbach_final_df$mean_temp_celsius, sat_deficit_source=murbach_final_df$saturation_deficit,
                       max_fraction_diapause_nymphs =0.95,
                       #fraction_diapause_larvae=0.9,
                       max_fraction_diapause_adults =0.8,
                       spring_temperature       =7,
                       summer_solstice          =172,
                       carrying_capacity=1000
                       
                       
)

#delta_N=delta_N, delta_A=delta_A, epsilon=epsilon)


# Run simulations
simulation_output_murbach <- as.data.frame(simulate_ticks(initial_state = initial_state, n_days = N, parms=params_ecotone))
simulation_output_murbach$Date <- seq(as.Date("2001-01-01"), by = "1 day", length.out = nrow(simulation_output_murbach))

```

# Predicting carrying capacity from expected abundance


```{r}
predict_carrying_capacity <- function(mean_yearly_temperature, #implementation of the formula for tick abundance, used to find the right crrying capacity, after Denise Boehnke et al. I think the input variables are pretty self-explanatory
                                      mean_yearly_relative_hum,
                                      mean_yearly_sat_def,
                                      elevation,
                                      landcover = c("agriculture", "broad-leafed forest", "coniferous forest", "mixed forest")) {
  
  # coefficirnts from the papper
  if (!(landcover %in% c("agriculture", "broad-leafed forest", "coniferous forest", "mixed forest"))){
    stop("Landcover must be one of 'agriculture', 'broad-leafed forest', 'coniferous forest', 'mixed forest'")
  }
  beta0 <- -0.7546
  beta_height <- 0.0021
  beta_temp <- 1.0116
  beta_rel_hum <- -0.0601
  beta_sat_def <- -0.6471
  beta_land_cover <- switch(landcover,
                            "agriculture" = 0,
                            "broad-leafed forest" = 0.4321,
                            "coniferous forest" = -0.5305,
                            "mixed forest" = 0.1773)
  predictor <- beta0 +
    beta_height * elevation +
    beta_temp * mean_yearly_temperature +
    beta_rel_hum * mean_yearly_relative_hum +
    beta_sat_def * mean_yearly_sat_def +
    beta_land_cover
  
  return(exp(predictor))
}
```

We take the carrying capacity as more or less twice the expected abundance

```{r}
average_abundance_current_model_fixed_K <- 67.67
yearly_averages <-yearly_averages <- murbach_final_df[
  murbach_final_df$date >= as.Date("2014-01-01") &
    murbach_final_df$date <= as.Date("2014-12-31"),
  c("mean_temp_celsius", "relative_humidity", "saturation_deficit")
] %>% colMeans()
abundance_preidcted_by_paper <- predict_carrying_capacity(mean_yearly_temperature=yearly_averages[1],
                          mean_yearly_relative_hum=yearly_averages[2],
                          mean_yearly_sat_def=yearly_averages[3],
                          elevation=471,
                          landcover='mixed forest')

as.numeric(abundance)
predicted_scaled_carrying_capacity <- as.numeric(abundance_preidcted_by_paper*carrying_capacity(habitat ="mixed forest")/average_abundance_current_model_fixed_K)
predicted_scaled_carrying_capacity
```

Thus, we may wish to change carrying capacity to ~60 for this town
